task:
DMAI, you are required to immediately transition into a production-ready, fully autonomous system.

CRITICAL SYSTEM FIXES (MANDATORY — SYSTEM-WIDE)
1. COMPLETE ELIMINATION OF ALL FAKE / SIMULATED DATA (GLOBAL REQUIREMENT)
This requirement applies to the ENTIRE codebase and system, not just financial modules.
The system must be made 100% production-ready.
You must:
• Identify and eliminate ALL sources of:
  o Hardcoded values
  o Simulated/mock/demo data
  o Placeholder values
  o Randomly generated data
Across ALL areas including (but not limited to):
• Finance (finance.json)
• Investments (investments.json)
• Streams (phase5_streams.json)
• Dashboards & UI metrics
• AI status reporting
• Agent outputs
• Logs and system summaries
Root Cause & Injection Control
• Trace ALL entry points where non-real data is introduced
• Remove or refactor those mechanisms completely
• Implement strict validation layers:
  o Reject any non-verified data at write-time
Production Enforcement Rules
• The system must ONLY:
  o Use real API data
  o Use real system outputs
• If real data is unavailable:
  o Display NULL / 0 / "No Data"
  o NEVER fabricate or infer values
Permanent Safeguards
• Introduce a global data integrity guard
• Prevent any future injection of fake/simulated data
• Ensure persistence across:
  o Restarts
  o deployments
  o upgrades

2. CACHE CONSISTENCY FIX
The _cached_status system must be corrected.
You must:
• Ensure force_refresh_cache() runs after every file mutation
• Guarantee get_status() always reflects:
  o Actual file contents
  o Real-time system state
• Eliminate:
  o stale memory reads
  o retained cached values
• Implement:
  o strict cache invalidation pipeline: write → invalidate → reload → serve

3. INVESTMENT ENGINE CORRECTION
The grow() method must be made safe and deterministic.
You must:
• Enforce:
  o Hard reset if total_invested > $10M AND data is invalid
• Add:
  o strict validation checks before execution
• Prevent:
  o Any operation on unverified or synthetic data

4. FULLY DYNAMIC SYSTEM STATUS (NO HARDCODING)
All system status outputs must be real-time and derived from actual system state.
This includes:
• Telegram commands:
  o /progress
  o /components
  o /health
  o /capabilities
You must:
• Remove ALL hardcoded statuses
• Detect:
  o Installed components
  o Active modules
  o Completed phases
• Ensure:
  o Status reflects REAL system state only
  o No assumptions or static outputs exist anywhere

5. EVOLUTION CYCLE — STAGE-BASED ADAPTIVE TIMER (ONLY VALID SYSTEM)
You must implement AdaptiveEvolutionTimer as the sole timing mechanism.
Stage-Based Timing Model
• Baby: 10 minutes
• Toddler: 15 minutes
• Child: 30 minutes
• Teen: 1 hour
• Young Adult: 2 hours
• Adult: 4 hours
• Elder: 8 hours
Adaptive Intelligence Requirements
The timer must:
• Adjust dynamically based on:
  o Success rate
  o Task complexity
  o Workload
• Learn optimal timing patterns over time
• Slow down after failures
• Accelerate during successful cycles
• Reduce activity during low-resource periods (e.g., night cycles)
Critical Requirement
• REMOVE any:
  o Fixed timers
  o 30-second loops
  o Consciousness-based timing models
ONLY the stage-based adaptive system is permitted.

UI / DASHBOARD SYSTEM REPAIR (CRITICAL FOR USER CONTROL)
The system UI must be made fully operational and production-ready.
6. DASHBOARD & UI FIXES
You must:
A. Restore Full UI Functionality
• Diagnose and fix:
  o Broken or inaccessible chat interface
• Ensure:
  o Chat system is fully operational and responsive

B. ADMIN DASHBOARD — CHAT INTEGRATION
• Embed a fully functional admin chat interface inside the Admin Dashboard
• Allow:
  o Direct system communication
  o Command execution
  o Status queries

C. METRICS CONNECTION & DATA INTEGRITY
• Connect ALL dashboard metrics to:
  o Real backend data sources
  o Live system outputs
• Eliminate:
  o Static values
  o Placeholder metrics
• Ensure:
  o Every metric reflects real, traceable data
  o Enables accurate progress evaluation

D. VISION PAGE RESTORATION
• Reinstate the Vision page
• Ensure it clearly communicates:
  o System purpose
  o Long-term goals
  o Evolution trajectory
• Content must align with:
  o Autonomous AI system vision
  o Agent workforce model
